summary: Fails on one count. The checker passes P-0 to P-13, but the guard requirement reads NOT MET: "not every variant has preShift cafe". The cause is guard-plain (weight 15, preShift none), added to fix last round's fault. That fault was mine, so this is a rules conflict, not a cast error: the checker wants every guard to stop at the café, which is shut before the 01:30 watch. Pulse raised it rather than settling it alone. Nothing else is wrong: debt and cash are weighted as needed, no row is over the cap, there are no backstories and names are mixed with no era.

faults.fault: The Handover requirement line for the guard role (regularOf cafe) reads NOT MET: 'not every variant has preShift cafe'. guard-plain (weight 15, preShift none, positions [guard]) breaks it. The tie share is fine: 16 of 16 guards hold a regular tie into the café (100%). It conflicts with last round's fix, which asked for a no-café variant for the 01:30 watch, when the diner (6–24) is shut.
faults.fix: Remove guard-plain, or give it preShift cafe, so every guard variant carries the café stop. Leave the closed café on the night watch to Keel/Motive as a rule question: either the sim drops a stop while its unit is shut, or the checker requires only one cafe variant. Pulse's note 2 already raises it.
